♍ The Virgo Cloth. CONTROL

Signature Technique

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Tenbu Horin]

Cloth Passive — Stillness

You can Refocus in 1 minute rather than 10. You gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves, and a +1 status bonus to AC for as long as you have not moved since the end of your last turn.

Ascendant Boon — Six Paths of Transmigration [CONTROL]

Each time you hit with an unarmed Strike, the target must attempt a Will save against your Cosmo DC or lose a sense. Losses are cumulative in this order: sight (blinded), hearing (deafened), smell and taste, then touch (−4 to attack rolls, and it cannot Grapple).

Senses lost this way return only through restoration or a full night's rest.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Virgo)]

Zenith Boon — Rikudo Rinne [CONTROL]

As the Ascendant Boon, and you gain @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Rikudo Rinne], usable once per minute.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Virgo)]

11th-Level Cloth Ability — Tenbu Horin (Greater)

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Tenbu Horin (Greater)]

rules.text: You also gain a +1 status bonus to AC while you have not moved since the end of your last turn, and you can Refocus in 1 minute.
rules.title: Stillness
